description: This file contains unit tests for the SchedulerFormValidator class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for TaskDefinition objects used in scheduling tasks.

classes.name: SchedulerFormValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the validation behavior of the SchedulerFormValidator, ensuring correct validation of name, taskClass, repeatInterval, and other properties of TaskDefinition objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the name of the TaskDefinition is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfTaskClassIsEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the taskClass of the TaskDefinition is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRepeatIntervalIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the repeatInterval of the TaskDefinition is missing or invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfClassIsNotInstanceOfTask
methods.description: Checks that validation errors occur if taskClass does not correspond to a class implementing Task.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfClassIsNotAccessible
methods.description: Simulates validation failure when the specified class cannot be loaded or accessed, e.g., due to class not found or illegal access.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfClassCannotBeInstantiated
methods.description: Tests validation error when the specified class cannot be instantiated.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfClassNotFound
methods.description: Checks validation error when the class specified by taskClass does not exist.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when all required fields of TaskDefinition are correctly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when string fields have acceptable lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation failure when string fields exceed maximum length constraints.
